positions.name: OwnedVsRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what distinguishes owned intelligence from rented intelligence, and what is the asset that ownership preserves?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read: src-1 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-2 identifies the substrate as commodity and perspective as the retained asset, and src-3 explicitly frames the pair as a restatement of the individually-owned-intelligence thesis — positioning the group as a thesis statement an extractor can connect to. The set holds no internal tension; each member reinforces the same read from a different angle.
